# Layer knobs (GENERATED by gen/build.py from layers/*.js; do not edit)

Format: `name: default` [min to max, step]. Put only the knobs you change in a shot's `params`.

## contour  (`layers/contour.js`)
Topographic contour lines (marching squares) over drifting noise terrain; index lines in accent.

- `cols: 110` [30 to 240, step 1]  Smoothness of the lines. Higher = smoother curves (and slower).
- `levels: 16` [3 to 40, step 1]  Number of contour lines, like the elevation lines on a hiking map.
- `scale: 2.4` [0.5 to 8, step 0.1]  Size of the hills. Higher = more, smaller hills.
- `octaves: 3` [1 to 5, step 1]  Roughness of the terrain. 1 = smooth blobs; 5 = craggy detail.
- `speed: 0.05` [0 to 0.5, step 0.005]  How fast the terrain changes shape.
- `drift: 0.03` [0 to 0.3, step 0.005]  How fast the map slides sideways.
- `width: 1.2` [0.3 to 5, step 0.1]  Line thickness.
- `index: 5` [0 to 10, step 1]  Every Nth line is a thicker accent line, like a map's index contours. 0 = none.
- `alpha: 0.75` [0.1 to 1, step 0.01]  Opacity. Lower = fainter.
- `trail: 0` [0 to 0.9, step 0.01]  Motion streaks. 0 = every frame starts clean; higher = moving things leave fading trails.
- `seed: 0` [0 to 999, step 1]  Reshuffles this layer's random choices (layout, timing). Same seed = same result.

## depth  (`layers/depth.js`)
Dot + wire 3D surfaces that morph into each other; perspective projection, depth-sorted dots, motion trails.

- `shapes: ['vase', 'sheet', 'torus', 'sphere']`  Shapes to morph through, in order, separated by commas: sphere, vase, torus, sheet, curl, plane, cylinder, knot.
- `hold: 6` [1 to 30, step 0.5]  Seconds each shape stays before it starts morphing.
- `morph: 2.5` [0.3 to 10, step 0.1]  Seconds the morph from one shape into the next takes.
- `nu: 24` [6 to 64, step 1]  Dots going around (columns). More = a denser mesh.
- `nv: 24` [6 to 64, step 1]  Dots going top to bottom (rows). More = a denser mesh.
- `size: 0.34` [0.1 to 1.2, step 0.01]  How big the shape is on screen.
- `focal: 1400` [300 to 4000, step 10]  Perspective strength. Low = dramatic fisheye depth; high = flat, like a diagram.
- `camZ: 0` [-1.5 to 4, step 0.05]  Pushes the shape away from you (+) or toward you (-).
- `camY: 0` [-2 to 2, step 0.01]  Camera height. + puts the shape below eye level, like looking out over a floor.
- `lift: 0` [-1 to 1, step 0.01]  Slides the whole picture up (-) or down (+). On a floor this moves the horizon.
- `fly: 0` [-3 to 3, step 0.05]  Floor (plane) shape only: how fast the floor slides toward you, for an endless flyover.
- `spinY: 14` [-90 to 90, step 1]  Turning speed around the vertical axis, in degrees per second. Negative turns the other way.
- `tiltX: -16` [-89 to 89, step 1]  Tips the shape toward or away from you, in degrees.
- `wobble: 7` [0 to 45, step 1]  A slow rocking motion on top of the tilt.
- `dot: 3.0` [0.5 to 12, step 0.1]  Dot size.
- `lines: 0.16` [0 to 1, step 0.01]  How visible the wireframe lines are. 0 = dots only.
- `fog: 0` [0 to 1, step 0.01]  Far dots fade into the background. 1 = the farthest ones vanish completely.
- `accent: 0.12` [0 to 1, step 0.01]  Share of items drawn in the accent color.
- `pulse: 0.35` [0 to 1.5, step 0.01]  How much things swell on each beat (the cartridge's BPM).
- `trail: 0.55` [0 to 0.97, step 0.01]  Motion streaks. 0 = every frame starts clean; higher = moving things leave fading trails.
- `seed: 0` [0 to 999, step 1]  Reshuffles this layer's random choices (layout, timing). Same seed = same result.

## dust  (`layers/dust.js`)
Letters burst into coloured powder (top-down slow motion) and dust coalesces back into crisp letters.

- `word: 'DUST'`  The word that bursts and re-forms (up to 14 characters; spaces leave gaps).
- `mode: { options: ['both', 'explode', 'assemble'], value: 'both' }`  both = letters burst, then dust re-forms them; explode = burst only; assemble = dust re-forms only.
- `grains: 3000` [500 to 6000, step 100]  How many dust grains. More = finer powder but slower; 3000 runs well, 6000 needs a fast machine.
- `size: 340` [80 to 600, step 5]  Letter size in pixels at 1080p. Long words shrink to fit the screen.
- `weight: 700` [100 to 900, step 100]  Font weight. Heavier letters hold more powder and read better as dust.
- `track: 0.03` [-0.1 to 0.4, step 0.01]  Space between letters, as a share of the letter size.
- `colors: ''`  Dust colours as hex codes separated by commas (2 to 6). Empty = taken from the palette.
- `hold: 1.8` [0 to 6, step 0.1]  Seconds the clean letters stay on screen at the start and end of each loop.
- `crack: 0.45` [0 to 2, step 0.05]  Seconds for the cracks to spread across a letter before it bursts (and to heal after it re-forms).
- `stagger: 0.16` [0 to 1, step 0.01]  Seconds between one letter and the next, left to right, in both directions.
- `burst: 3.8` [1 to 8, step 0.1]  Seconds of simulated burst. Longer = the cloud travels further before it turns around.
- `slow: 1.35` [0.5 to 3, step 0.05]  How much slower the re-forming plays than the burst. 1 = same speed; higher = slow-motion coalesce.
- `chunks: 13` [3 to 30, step 1]  How many pieces each letter cracks into. Few = big clumps; many = finer break-up.
- `impulse: 330` [0 to 900, step 10]  How hard the pieces are thrown outward across the floor when a letter lands.
- `fan: 1.3` [0 to 3.1, step 0.05]  How much each piece's direction is randomised. Higher = pieces cross paths and the colours mix.
- `spread: 1.3` [0 to 4, step 0.05]  How fast each piece loses its own shape. Higher = clumps melt into haze sooner.
- `jitter: 80` [0 to 300, step 5]  Random speed each grain gets at impact. Higher = fuzzier edges from the start.
- `diffuse: 110` [0 to 400, step 5]  Ongoing random jostle of every grain. Higher = blob edges dissolve; 0 = clumps stay crisp.
- `splash: 520` [0 to 1500, step 10]  How hard powder is thrown up toward the camera. Higher = bigger, closer puffs at the centre.
- `gravity: 900` [0 to 3000, step 50]  Pulls the splashed powder back down to the floor. Lower = puffs hang in the air longer.
- `drag: 1.15` [0.1 to 5, step 0.05]  Air drag. Lower = the cloud keeps travelling across the screen; higher = it stops close to the letter.
- `floor: 0.45` [0 to 4, step 0.05]  Extra friction for powder sliding on the floor.
- `swirl: 230` [0 to 800, step 10]  Strength of the swirling air that makes the dust billow. 0 = straight lines outward.
- `swirlScale: 0.0045` [0.001 to 0.02, step 0.0005]  Size of the swirls. Lower = big lazy eddies; higher = small tight curls.
- `swirlSpeed: 0.45` [0 to 2, step 0.05]  How fast the swirl pattern changes over time.
- `windX: 30` [-200 to 200, step 5]  Steady sideways drift of the whole cloud (pixels per second; negative = to the left).
- `windY: -12` [-200 to 200, step 5]  Steady up/down drift of the whole cloud (pixels per second; negative = up).
- `grow: 8` [0 to 20, step 0.5]  How large each puff grows as it spreads. Higher = puffs merge into one soft cloud.
- `growRate: 1.1` [0.2 to 4, step 0.05]  How quickly the puffs reach full size.
- `mix: 0.38` [0.05 to 1, step 0.01]  Puff opacity once fully spread. Lower = puffs melt together and the colours blend.
- `persp: 0.0009` [0 to 0.004, step 0.0001]  Depth effect: powder thrown toward the camera looks bigger and drifts outward.
- `grit: 0.03` [0 to 0.2, step 0.005]  Share of grains that are fast, tiny bright specks flying off the cloud.
- `res: 0.5` [0.25 to 1, step 0.05]  Resolution of the dust layer (share of the screen). Lower = faster and softer.
- `glow: 0.24` [0 to 1, step 0.01]  Soft spotlight behind the letters.
- `bokeh: 7` [0 to 20, step 1]  How many large out-of-focus light discs drift in the background.
- `vignette: 0.6` [0 to 1, step 0.05]  How dark the corners get.
- `trail: 0` [0 to 0.95, step 0.01]  Motion streaks. 0 = every frame starts clean; higher = moving things leave fading trails.
- `seed: 0` [0 to 999, step 1]  Reshuffles this layer's random choices (layout, timing). Same seed = same result.

## field  (`layers/field.js`)  · stateful, warm-up 3 s
Flow-field particles: noise sets a direction at every point, particles follow it and leave streaks.

- `count: 1400` [100 to 6000, step 50]  Number of particles. More = denser streams (and slower).
- `speed: 90` [5 to 400, step 1]  How fast the particles move.
- `scale: 2.2` [0.3 to 10, step 0.1]  Size of the swirls. Higher = smaller, busier swirls.
- `swirl: 2.2` [0.5 to 6, step 0.1]  How twisty the currents are.
- `evolve: 0.06` [0 to 0.5, step 0.005]  How fast the currents themselves change shape.
- `life: 7` [1 to 20, step 0.5]  Seconds before a particle disappears and starts again somewhere else.
- `width: 1.3` [0.3 to 6, step 0.1]  Line thickness.
- `alpha: 0.55` [0.05 to 1, step 0.01]  Opacity. Lower = fainter.
- `accent: 0.08` [0 to 1, step 0.01]  Share of items drawn in the accent color.
- `trail: 0.94` [0.5 to 0.995, step 0.001]  Motion streaks. 0 = every frame starts clean; higher = moving things leave fading trails.
- `seed: 0` [0 to 999, step 1]  Reshuffles this layer's random choices (layout, timing). Same seed = same result.

## halftone  (`layers/halftone.js`)
Halftone dot screens driven by ripples, noise, rings or a big word; two overprinted screens like a riso print.

- `field: { options: ['ripples', 'noise', 'rings', 'text'], value: 'ripples' }`  What shapes the dots: ripples, noise (clouds), rings (pulse on the beat), or text (a big word).
- `text: 'COLOR'`  The word, when field is "text".
- `cell: 22` [8 to 60, step 1]  Dot spacing. Smaller = finer print (and slower).
- `angleA: 45` [0 to 90, step 1]  Angle of the first dot grid, in degrees.
- `angleB: 15` [0 to 90, step 1]  Angle of the second (accent) grid. A different angle from the first makes moiré patterns.
- `offset: 0.35` [0 to 2, step 0.01]  Misregistration: how far the two inks are shifted from each other, like a cheap print job.
- `screens: 2` [1 to 2, step 1]  1 = one ink. 2 = two inks printed over each other.
- `scale: 3` [0.5 to 12, step 0.1]  Size of the ripples or clouds. Higher = smaller and busier.
- `speed: 0.5` [0 to 3, step 0.01]  Motion speed.
- `gamma: 0.9` [0.3 to 3, step 0.05]  Dot growth curve. Higher = more small dots and punchier contrast.
- `square: 0` [0 to 1, step 1]  On = square dots.
- `trail: 0` [0 to 0.9, step 0.01]  Motion streaks. 0 = every frame starts clean; higher = moving things leave fading trails.
- `seed: 0` [0 to 999, step 1]  Reshuffles this layer's random choices (layout, timing). Same seed = same result.

## harmonograph  (`layers/harmonograph.js`)
Damped-pendulum pen drawings (harmonograph): each figure draws itself with a glowing pen, then fades.

- `period: 16` [5 to 60, step 0.5]  Seconds per drawing before a new one starts.
- `fade: 2.5` [0.5 to 10, step 0.1]  Seconds of crossfade between one drawing and the next.
- `damp: 0.011` [0.002 to 0.05, step 0.001]  How fast the swinging dies down. Higher = shorter, tighter drawings.
- `detune: 0.012` [0 to 0.06, step 0.001]  How far off perfect the pendulums are. 0 = one closed loop; more = lacy drifting layers.
- `rotary: 0.8` [0 to 4, step 0.05]  How far the paper turns while it draws (the spirograph twist).
- `size: 0.42` [0.1 to 0.6, step 0.01]  Drawing size.
- `points: 3600` [500 to 12000, step 100]  Smoothness of the line.
- `width: 1.3` [0.3 to 5, step 0.1]  Pen thickness.
- `alpha: 0.85` [0.1 to 1, step 0.01]  Opacity. Lower = fainter.
- `head: 3.2` [0 to 10, step 0.1]  Size of the glowing pen dot. 0 = none.
- `trail: 0` [0 to 0.9, step 0.01]  Motion streaks. 0 = every frame starts clean; higher = moving things leave fading trails.
- `seed: 0` [0 to 999, step 1]  Reshuffles this layer's random choices (layout, timing). Same seed = same result.

## julia  (`layers/julia.js`)
Animated Julia set fractal at low resolution, upscaled; c orbits a circle so the shape keeps folding.

- `res: 300` [80 to 720, step 10]  Pixel resolution. Lower = chunkier pixels and faster.
- `iter: 64` [16 to 220, step 1]  Detail at the edge of the shape. Higher = finer filaments (and slower).
- `radius: 0.7885` [0.3 to 1, step 0.0005]  Which fractal you get. Tiny changes give very different shapes; 0.7885 is a classic.
- `speed: 0.05` [0 to 0.5, step 0.005]  How fast the shape folds and changes.
- `zoom: 1` [0.3 to 6, step 0.01]  Zooms in on the center.
- `breathe: 0.12` [0 to 0.6, step 0.01]  Slow zooming in and out.
- `glow: 0.55` [0.15 to 1.5, step 0.01]  Lower = the glow spreads further out from the shape.
- `bands: 4` [1 to 16, step 0.5]  Number of color ripples around the shape.
- `flow: 0.15` [0 to 2, step 0.01]  How fast the ripples move outward.
- `pixel: 1` [0 to 1, step 1]  On = hard retro pixels. Off = smoothed.
- `seed: 0` [0 to 999, step 1]  Reshuffles this layer's random choices (layout, timing). Same seed = same result.

## reaction  (`layers/reaction.js`)  · stateful, warm-up 4 s
Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion: self-growing Turing patterns (coral, mitosis, maze, worms ...).

- `pattern: { options: Object.keys(PRESETS), value: 'coral' }`  Which pattern grows: coral, mitosis (dividing cells), maze, worms, spots, waves, fingerprint.
- `feedShift: 0` [-0.01 to 0.01, step 0.0005]  Fine-tunes the pattern. Small moves change the look a lot; drag slowly.
- `killShift: 0` [-0.005 to 0.005, step 0.0002]  Fine-tunes the pattern the other way. Small moves change the look a lot.
- `sweep: 0.004` [0 to 0.02, step 0.0005]  Makes the left and right sides of the screen grow slightly different patterns.
- `res: 220` [80 to 480, step 10]  Grid detail. Higher = finer pattern, but much slower.
- `rate: 540` [60 to 1800, step 10]  Growth speed.
- `seeds: 14` [1 to 80, step 1]  Number of starting spots the pattern grows from.
- `drops: 5` [0 to 30, step 0.5]  Seconds between new spots dropped in, so it never settles. 0 = none.
- `prerun: 400` [0 to 4000, step 50]  How far grown it already is when the shot starts.
- `contrast: 2.6` [1 to 6, step 0.1]  Color strength.
- `pixel: 0` [0 to 1, step 1]  On = hard pixels. Off = smooth.
- `seed: 0` [0 to 999, step 1]  Reshuffles this layer's random choices (layout, timing). Same seed = same result.

## stack  (`layers/stack.js`)  · stateful, warm-up 3 s
Composites several layers in one shot (bottom first) with blend modes; e.g. kinetic type over a tunnel.

- `layers: [{ layer: 'contour' }, { layer: 'type', blend: 'source-over', params: { backdrop: 0 } }]`  The layers in this shot, bottom first. Each one: layer, params, blend (screen, multiply, overlay ...), alpha.

## tree  (`layers/tree.js`)
Recursive branching fractal; grows in once, then sways. arms > 1 makes a radial mandala.

- `depth: 10` [3 to 13, step 1]  Branching levels. Each level doubles the branches; 11 and up gets very dense.
- `arms: 1` [1 to 12, step 1]  1 = one tree growing from the bottom. 2 or more = a radial snowflake/mandala from the center.
- `spread: 24` [2 to 90, step 1]  Angle between branches. Small = tall and narrow; big = wide and bushy.
- `ratio: 0.76` [0.5 to 0.9, step 0.01]  How long each branch is compared to its parent. Higher = bigger, fuller tree.
- `length: 0.24` [0.05 to 0.6, step 0.01]  Trunk length.
- `asym: 0.15` [0 to 0.6, step 0.01]  Randomness, so the branches aren't perfectly symmetrical.
- `sway: 7` [0 to 40, step 0.5]  How far the branches move in the breeze.
- `swaySpeed: 0.3` [0 to 2, step 0.01]  How fast the breeze is.
- `spin: 0` [-30 to 30, step 0.5]  Rotation speed of the mandala (arms 2+), in degrees per second.
- `grow: 6` [0 to 30, step 0.5]  Seconds it takes to grow in at the start of the shot. 0 = already fully grown.
- `width: 7` [0.5 to 20, step 0.1]  Trunk thickness; the branches thin out from there.
- `leaves: 0.5` [0 to 1, step 0.01]  Chance of an accent-colored bud at each branch tip.
- `pulse: 0.4` [0 to 1.5, step 0.01]  How much things swell on each beat (the cartridge's BPM).
- `trail: 0` [0 to 0.9, step 0.01]  Motion streaks. 0 = every frame starts clean; higher = moving things leave fading trails.
- `seed: 0` [0 to 999, step 1]  Reshuffles this layer's random choices (layout, timing). Same seed = same result.

## truchet  (`layers/truchet.js`)
Truchet tiles rewired by travelling waves; tiles turn 90 degrees and change color as a wave passes.

- `cell: 96` [30 to 240, step 1]  Size of each tile. Smaller = more, finer tiles.
- `width: 0.17` [0.02 to 0.45, step 0.01]  Thickness of the curved lines.
- `waves: 3` [1 to 6, step 1]  How many wave centers ripple across the tiles.
- `wavelength: 9` [2 to 40, step 0.5]  Distance between wave crests, in tiles. Bigger = broader bands of color.
- `speed: 1.2` [0 to 6, step 0.05]  How fast the waves travel across the screen.
- `sharp: 5` [1 to 20, step 0.5]  How suddenly a tile flips as a wave passes. Low = soft shimmer; high = crisp bands.
- `drift: 0.05` [0 to 0.5, step 0.01]  How fast the wave centers wander around the screen.
- `gapA: 0` [0 to 1, step 0.01]  Gaps in the lines in the resting color. 0 = solid unbroken loops; higher = short dashes.
- `gapB: 0.35` [0 to 1, step 0.01]  Gaps in the lines in the flipped (accent) color.
- `spin: 1` [0 to 1, step 1]  On: tiles turn as a wave passes, rewiring the maze. Off: they only change color.
- `breathe: 0.15` [0 to 1, step 0.01]  Lines get thicker on each beat.
- `trail: 0` [0 to 0.9, step 0.01]  Motion streaks. 0 = every frame starts clean; higher = moving things leave fading trails.
- `seed: 0` [0 to 999, step 1]  Reshuffles this layer's random choices (layout, timing). Same seed = same result.

## tunnel  (`layers/tunnel.js`)
Demoscene wormhole: rings fly at the camera along a bending path; wire, dots or checkerboard panels.

- `style: { options: ['wire', 'dots', 'checker'], value: 'wire' }`  wire = ring outlines, dots = points only, checker = filled panels.
- `sides: 24` [3 to 64, step 1]  Corners on each ring: 3 = triangle tunnel, 6 = hexagon, 24+ = round.
- `rings: 46` [8 to 120, step 1]  Rings on screen at once, i.e. how far down the tunnel you can see.
- `spacing: 0.45` [0.1 to 2, step 0.01]  Gap between rings.
- `size: 0.5` [0.1 to 1.5, step 0.01]  How wide the tunnel is on screen.
- `speed: 2.2` [-8 to 12, step 0.05]  Flying speed. Negative flies backwards.
- `twist: 0.12` [-1 to 1, step 0.01]  How much each ring is turned from the last. Makes spirals.
- `spin: 0.15` [-2 to 2, step 0.01]  Rotation speed of the whole tunnel.
- `bend: 0.9` [0 to 4, step 0.05]  How much the tunnel curves.
- `bendSpeed: 0.06` [0 to 0.5, step 0.005]  How quickly the curves come at you.
- `fog: 0.9` [0 to 1, step 0.01]  Far rings fade into the background.
- `lines: 0.55` [0 to 1, step 0.01]  Brightness of the ring lines.
- `dot: 2.4` [0.5 to 10, step 0.1]  Dot size (wire and dots styles).
- `fill: 0.5` [0 to 1, step 0.01]  Panel brightness (checker style).
- `accentEvery: 6` [0 to 20, step 1]  Every Nth ring is in the accent color. 0 = none.
- `pulse: 0.6` [0 to 2, step 0.01]  How much things swell on each beat (the cartridge's BPM).
- `trail: 0` [0 to 0.9, step 0.01]  Motion streaks. 0 = every frame starts clean; higher = moving things leave fading trails.
- `seed: 0` [0 to 999, step 1]  Reshuffles this layer's random choices (layout, timing). Same seed = same result.

## type  (`layers/type.js`)
Kinetic typography from a timed script: 15 effects named like delivery directions, color floods, Whisper import.

- `script: []`  The words and their timing. Edit them in the SCRIPT box below.
- `weight: 800` [100 to 900, step 100]  How bold the letters are.
- `size: 0.26` [0.05 to 0.6, step 0.01]  Base word size. Long words are shrunk to fit the screen anyway.
- `maxw: 0.88` [0.3 to 1, step 0.01]  The widest a line may get, as a share of the screen width.
- `tracking: 0.02` [-0.1 to 0.4, step 0.01]  Space between letters.
- `caps: 1` [0 to 1, step 1]  On = ALL CAPS. A line's "lower" direction overrides it.
- `fx: { options: FX, value: 'slam' }`  The effect for script lines that don't name one.
- `exit: 0.3` [0.05 to 1.5, step 0.05]  Seconds each line takes to leave the screen.
- `flood: { options: ['iris', 'wipe', 'fade'], value: 'iris' }`  How a bg= color fills the screen: iris (a circle growing from the word), wipe, or fade.
- `floodTime: 0.45` [0.15 to 2, step 0.05]  Seconds a color flood takes. Kept slow enough that it can never flash.
- `backdrop: 1` [0 to 1, step 1]  On = solid background. Off = transparent, for text over another layer in a stack.
- `karaoke: 1` [0 to 1, step 1]  In phrase lines, the word being said lights up in the accent color.
- `pulse: 0.3` [0 to 1, step 0.01]  How much things swell on each beat (the cartridge's BPM).
- `trail: 0` [0 to 0.9, step 0.01]  Motion streaks. 0 = every frame starts clean; higher = moving things leave fading trails.
- `seed: 0` [0 to 999, step 1]  Reshuffles this layer's random choices (layout, timing). Same seed = same result.

## depth shapes (`m3d.js`)
`sphere`, `vase`, `torus`, `sheet`, `curl`, `plane`, `cylinder`, `knot`
